[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 69[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to another Hack Forum News edition. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2745296]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6333316][color=#ffffff]Octoberfest 2026 w/new Award Goal[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Hack Forums has officially kicked off its Octoberfest 2026 give away putting over $1,000 in prizes up for grabs in the event. Sponsored by [mention=5451242] the event features $700 in cash prizes, ten permanent membership upgrades, and the exclusive Lucky Award for all drawing winners chosen on November 1st. Members automatically earn entries simply by posting and creating threads with higher activity earning better odds. On top of the random drawings users can also secure the limited 2026 Red Pumpkin profile award by hitting 300 posts and creating 30 threads before the event wraps up. Which prizes are you setting your sights on this October? Share your thoughts and feedback in the original thread.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6333311][color=#ffffff]Site Notifications and Web-Push[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

With the old notification system slowed down by legacy code and outdated browser handling [mention=1] has completely rebuilt alerts to modern standards. The major overhaul introduces light weight real time on site notifications along side native browser and OS push alerts for PMs, mentions, quotes, and thread replies even when you do not have Hack Forums open. While background deliveries are running smoothly members should report any bugs. Have you tested out the new push alerts yet?

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6333220][color=#ffffff]Header Icons[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

Following the recent Font Awesome update [mention=1] is experimenting with visual tweaks across the forum header and seeking member feedback on a potential style change. The proposed update would switch the current header icons from solid to light variants for a cleaner aesthetic with the private message icon already being swapped out from the paper plane to the traditional envelope. Input is being gathered before locking in the new icon weight site wide. Do you prefer the bold solid icons or the sleeker light style? Share your thoughts and feedback in the original thread.

This week's submission is thanks to [mention=2195096]

This weeks movie of the week of the week is really not a movie but a series on amazon prime video. Yes we are breaking the rules a little but we know a lot of good shows these days are series and we think this stil fits well within the section.

The show itself is a action series based off a book known as Jack Reacher series. [mention=2195096] has shared with us that a new season is dropping soon and wanted to know if anyone else is following along.
